tagline: Queenstown's STIHL dealer for outdoor power equipment
heroSubheading: Complete STIHL range and expert help for outdoor work.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Queenstown, run by Murray Wilson. We stock the full range of STIHL professional outdoor power equipment, from reliable chainsaws and string trimmers to leaf blowers, edgers, and many other tools. Whatever you're tackling, whether it's clearing land, maintaining your garden, or keeping your property or business running smoothly, we have the right gear to get the job done well.

Our team knows Queenstown through and through. We understand the landscape and weather here, and we know what STIHL equipment performs best in our conditions and terrain. We can help you find the right tools and answer your questions about getting good results from them.

Stop by and see what we have in stock. We're here Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, ready to help you get sorted.
